svg.title: Vale promises to fund outcomes while Ila assesses him from behind.
svg.desc: Vale speaks with calm sincerity, one gloved hand open and the silver tablet held low. Ila watches with her spectacles in hand, while an uncut ribbon and blank announcement banner quietly undercut the pledge.
svg.text: Page 3, panel 4 · Frontal medium shot of Vale at the platform edge

text.tspan: Vale promises that the Mission will measure
delivered services rather than ceremonial claims.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
